title: Certify the complex motif ratio below the manuscript power
body:
## Summary
- The complex motif displays rank sum `s_c = 1873807244636671267308000000` and deficit `2(N - L_c)` with `L_c/N = 101/539`. Rebuilding that deficit recovers `eta = 73/19906842167500` and `s_c/W_c = m(1-eta)`.
- `2^{50} eta` exceeds six times the ninth harmonic number, and that harmonic number exceeds `ln(10)`. For a width-1 list of length `s_c`, Psi at `sigma = 1-2^{-50}` is below 1.
- No network replay and no new exponent. Both displayed motif ratios now clear the same logarithm bound.

## Test plan
